arguments.summary: The pgbouncer service is currently degraded with no worker throughput, which could be indicative of a broader issue. The failed_jobs table export shows 1204 jobs in a failed state as of 12 minutes ago, with 47 malformed rows. I recommend investigating the root cause of the degraded state of pgbouncer and resolving any potential issues to prevent further failures. The export of the failed_jobs table will be used for the postmortem analysis.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the degraded state of pgbouncer and resolve any potential issues to prevent further failures. Additionally, review and address any malformed rows in the failed_jobs table to ensure data integrity.
